mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.patient_id, a.doctor_id, a.appointment_time, a.time_slot, a.status, a.symptom_description, a.fee, a.order_number, a.department_location, a.created_time, a.updated_time, p.name AS patient_name, p.phone AS patient_phone, d.name AS doctor_name, d.title AS doctor_title, d.avatar_url AS doctor_avatar, dept.name AS department_name FROM appointments a LEFT JOIN patients p ON a.patient_id = p.id LEFT JOIN doctors d ON a.doctor_id = d.id LEFT JOIN departments dept ON d.department_id = dept.id WHERE a.patient_id = #{patientId} ORDER BY a.appointment_time DESC

SELECT a.id, a.patient_id, a.doctor_id, a.appointment_time, a.time_slot, a.status, a.symptom_description, a.fee, a.order_number, a.department_location, a.created_time, a.updated_time, p.name AS patient_name, p.phone AS patient_phone, d.name AS doctor_name, d.title AS doctor_title, d.avatar_url AS doctor_avatar, dept.name AS department_name FROM appointments a LEFT JOIN patients p ON a.patient_id = p.id LEFT JOIN doctors d ON a.doctor_id = d.id LEFT JOIN departments dept ON d.department_id = dept.id WHERE a.doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND DATE(a.appointment_time) >= CURDATE() AND a.status IN (0, 1) ORDER BY a.appointment_time ASC, a.time_slot ASC
